Marcus / Neha —

Drafted a commercial outline based on Sara’s answers:
- Current: 16 GPU reserved pool (monthly billed hours, baseline)
- Proposed: 32 GPU reserved pool (12-month term), billing start 2027-01-01, deployment kickoff 2026-12-15
- Pricing: reserved per-hour rate: $5.40/hr per GPU (standard 16 pool pricing is $5.90/hr) -> for 32 GPUs, Redwood proposes a blended effective rate of $5.40/hr per GPU with a commitment of 24/7 reserved capacity.
- Burst policy: 20% burstable capacity at on-demand rates with automatic soft-throttle at 95th percentile to protect SLOs
- Throughput SLOs: will commit to p50/p95 latency targets for the model family listed; include SLA credits for availability below 99.5% monthly (credit schedule in SOW)

I’ve attached a short SOW and a one-page amendment for legal review. Neha — can you produce a line-item quote PDF for procurement and the DocuSign envelope?

Karthik
Account Executive

Hi Sara / Tom —

Appreciate the quick info. Attached is our proposed amendment (Nimbus_Redwood_Amendment_v2.pdf) and the SOW for the 32-GPU rollout. Highlights below:

Summary of commercial terms
- Term: 12 months (2027-01-01 → 2027-12-31)
- Capacity: Dedicated reserved pool increased from 16 → 32 GPUs (continuous reserved allocation)
- Reserved per-GPU rate: $5.40/hour (applies to committed pool); estimated monthly reserved spend at 32 GPUs = $125,000 (approx, depends on month length)
- Upfront credit: 5% one-time onboarding credit applied to first invoice (as agreed during partner call)
- Burst: up to +20% capacity at on-demand rates; higher burst available via scheduled capacity increases
- SLOs: p50 < 120ms, p95 < 450ms for the agreed model family; SLA credits tiered for availability below 99.5%

Operational notes
- Deployment window: Dec 15–24 to stage and validate the additional nodes; final cutover Jan 1, 2027.
- Migration: prefix KV caching will be warmed via synthetic traffic; we’ll coordinate a low-traffic cutover window.
- Rollback: if performance regressions are observed within first 14 days after cutover, we’ll execute a predefined rollback playbook to return to 16 GPUs while we remediate.

Next steps
1) Please review the attached amendment and SOW.
2) If the terms look good, Tom can sign via DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/sign/ABCD-1234-EXAMPLE
3) Neha will provide an official quote PDF for your PO and a HubSpot deal link for internal tracking: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567

I’m available for a 30-minute handoff call if you want to walk the SOW and cutover plan (Karthik and Neha will join).

Thanks,

Marcus Lin
